name: cucp
description: Windows Computer Use Control Plane for local desktop observation, grounded GUI automation, verification, and safety-gated live control.

interface.longDescription: CUCP exposes a local Windows computer-use runtime for observing desktop state, grounding UI targets through Win32, UI Automation, OCR, and optional Chromium CDP, then executing live actions only through explicit safety gates.
defaultPrompt: Plan a safety-gated Windows GUI automation step.
